items.prompt: Why is a current complete-looking database extract insufficient to certify a historical strategy universe?
items.modelAnswer: Current constituents/survivors may reflect future membership or survival;revised values may differ from historical vintages. Need dated source-available membership,permanent IDs and mappings,delisting/terminal cashflows,missing policies,extract/version/query lineage and counts. Database coverage claims alone do not validate this query.
